what: The job and product card row slides two cards at a time every 5 seconds in .9s with owl.carousel 2.3.4 (loops endlessly, pauses on hover, drag to slide). 40px between cards, and card width stays its own width (autoWidth). Numbered dots 1·2·3… at the top right (the current one in accent color + 3px underline), with round arrows on both sides. Below 950 width: one card at a time, centered, 20px apart. Below 750 the dots are plain circles without numbers

options.by: Number of items advanced at once, default 2 (1 below width 950)
options.gap: Gap between cards (px), default 40 (20 under width 950)
options.numbers: on (default) numbers the dots 1·2·3 — off gives plain circles
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cards. If empty, all children of the element

use: ………
note: owl is a jQuery plugin, so load ../_vendor/jquery@3.7.1/jquery.min.js and ../_vendor/owl.carousel@2.3.4/ (min.js + min.css) first. Owl blocks dragging, so use it with a panel that doesn’t cover the whole screen height

from.where: index.html .js-recruit-slider (recommended jobs) · recruit.html (jobs at the same workplace) — original .js-box-recruit-slider owlCarousel (margin 40 · loop · autoplay · autoplaySpeed 900 · autoWidth · slideBy 2 · 0:{items 1, margin 20, center} · 950:{items 2}) and dot numbering.
